svg.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 scores as well as any model, for the least
svg.desc: RealKIE invoices, 20 documents × 3 runs: Nova 2 Lite 77% at $25.1 per 1,000 documents, Haiku 5.5 (baseline setup) 80% at $23.0 per 1,000 documents, Sonnet 5.5 82% at $85.0 per 1,000 documents, Opus 5.5 83% at $150 per 1,000 documents, GPT-6 Astra 85% at $601 per 1,000 documents, Grok 4.6 83% at $59.2 per 1,000 documents; Fake-W2 forms, 20 documents × 3 runs: Nova 2 Lite 86% at $8.51 per 1,000 documents, Haiku 5.5 (baseline setup) 100% at $7.42 per 1,000 documents, Sonnet 5.5 100% at $20.7 per 1,000 documents, Opus 5.5 100% at $37.6 per 1,000 documents, GPT-6 Astra 100% at $96.9 per 1,000 documents, Grok 4.6 100% at $22.0 per 1,000 documents; Baseline setup: Amazon Textract with Layout only; holistic classification reading text and page images, single-pass extraction with structured output, and confidence scoring, all on Claude Haiku 5.5, with no escalation to a second scoring model.
